_schema_note: Per-scorer, per-model percentile bands. Used by scripts/clip_score.py to translate raw scores into model-aware bands. Nested by scorer since CLIP and SigLIP 2 have different raw-score scales. SigLIP 2 defaults below are a small-sample bootstrap (n=5, own-prompt vs. mismatched-prompt fixtures scored 2026-08-11 on this repo's Studio) with real prompt-match discrimination confirmed (0.165 own-prompt vs -0.105 wrong-prompt, stable across 3 runs) — NOT yet a proper percentile calibration. Refresh with scripts/calibrate_clip.py --scorer siglip2 once >=20 real generations accumulate per model.
_units: raw cosine similarity (SigLIP 2 and CLIP both report cosine similarity between L2-normalized embeddings)
_bands: p50 = median, p25 = lower quartile, p10 = bottom decile. A score below the p10 of its model strongly suggests re-generation.
